resource: Item-use commits (DUR-03 one-item transactions) per Channel
allocation_impact: Qualification budget, not a runtime cutoff: per-actor admission (ITEMUSE0-RL-01, the one use in flight and the cooldowns) bounds the offered load; a Channel whose item-use load would exceed this budget needs a new measurement before it ships.
boundary_tests: measured: apps/game-server/tests/support/item_use_postgres_cases.rs item_use_commit_throughput_is_measured (99 sequential flask-stack potion uses on one Character)
notes: Measured by ITEM-USE-1c (#1622) on 2026-10-13 on the ITEM-USE-0 §4.4 flask shape (FlaskStack: source unit burned, target flask stack grown, TRANSFORM recorded) against a local PostgreSQL 17 instance, sequential commits on one connection: 115, 119 and 119 commits/s over three runs; the lowest is registered (an earlier one-item Burn measurement, 120 to 133 commits/s, was the cheaper shape and is not the registered evidence). Not production hardware; re-measure on the qualified database before raising.
